protocol.selection_timing: Fixed sine was selected after its success on the 30 archived instances; this is subsequent validation, not a historical held-out evaluation or formal preregistration.
protocol.inclusion: Every seed-difficulty task in the fixed plan, including all-zero forcing, all-zero solutions, generation/solver/identification errors. No retries or exclusions.
protocol.environment: Original-resolution native solve_elliptic and unchanged ProbeSession.query/solve; no banded substitution or grid refinement.
protocol.scoring: Sum of per-field maximum absolute coefficient errors from unrounded internal estimates; E<0.01 primary. Displayed 8dp errors also retained.
protocol.units: 100 tasks per difficulty. The same seed labels are reused across difficulties, with related generator RNG streams; no pooled 300-task independent-binomial interval is claimed.
protocol.intervals: Wilson 95% marginal intervals per difficulty over all 100 planned tasks; execution failures count as non-successes. Assumes seed-generated task sampling and conditions on this generator and fixed design.
protocol.zero_source_subsets: Descriptive counts only; zero-source tasks remain in all primary denominators.
